thread:
riley: Opening a small PR to add a compact metering CSV example, an SDK header snippet, and a Grafana panel asset for the rate/quotas pages. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4592. Asking for quick eyes because support sometimes references these examples during escalations.

zara: Can you paste the CSV header we'll ship? Must include billing_event_id and ISO UTC timestamps per ingestion contract.

riley: CSV header I added:

```csv
timestamp_iso,billing_event_id,account_id,plan,tokens,endpoint,status_code
```
sample row: `2026-04-02T11:30:00Z,evt_9f8e7d,acct_42,enterprise,1024,/v1/complete,200`

miko: For SDK header snippet, include both Python and tiny Node examples that print `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Also call out that `Remaining` can transiently go negative under concurrency.

arjun: Add a short burst credit blurb: show gross tokens series and net tokens series (net = tokens - burst_credit). Maybe a one-line formula and an example row demonstrating a spike where 300 tokens are netted down to 100 after applying 200 burst credits.

riley: Added a 5-row mini dataset demonstrating a 2-minute spike and an applied burst credit. Also included a note in `docs/pricing/tiers.md` clarifying that panels aggregate hourly while quotas are enforced per-minute.

docs-ci-bot: CI: linkcheck failed (old grafana link found in docs/billing/overview.md).

zara: Please replace the old grafana path with the new stored panel asset path `docs/assets/panels/metering-summary.json` so links in the repo are self-contained for offline previews.

riley: Done, pushed a fix. I also added `billing_event_id` to the discrepancy investigation example in `docs/support/troubleshooting.md`.

miko: Tiny nit: ensure the panel's plan order is `free,pro,enterprise` so stacked colors line up with the narrative. I left a comment on the panel JSON.

arjun: Also include a brief note about timezone normalization in the CSV doc: ingestion assumes UTC, non-UTC rows are rejected. That helped us avoid a customer mismatch last month.

riley: Included that note. PR description lists: `examples/metering-sample.csv`, `assets/panels/metering-summary.json`, `snippets/sdk_headers_py.js` (typo: name will be fixed), and small edits to `pricing/tiers.md` and `support/troubleshooting.md`.

docs-ci-bot: CI re-run: markdown lint passed, linkcheck passed, panel JSON validated.

zara: LGTM from me after the tiny filename nit.

miko: LGTM on content.

arjun: Approved. Merge when green.

riley: Merging now and adding a changelog entry: "docs: add metering CSV + SDK header snippets + panel asset; clarify burst credits and quota aggregation"

(END)
